rules.title: Server secret reachable from client code
rules.description: A secret-shaped env key is either inlined into the client bundle via NEXT_PUBLIC_* or referenced inside a client component.

rules.title: Supabase table without row-level security
rules.description: A CREATE TABLE in a Supabase migration without ALTER TABLE ... ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, or a policy USING (true).

rules.title: Server-only module imported into client code
rules.description: A client component imports a server-only module (fs, next/headers, a server lib, a DB client): the import either breaks the build or leaks server code into the bundle.

rules.title: Route handler consumes unvalidated input
rules.description: A POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE route handler reads request.json()/formData() and uses it without a schema/validation call.

rules.title: Protected route without a session check
rules.description: A page or route handler under a protected prefix (app/dashboard, app/admin, app/account, app/(protected)) with no session/user check in its file or a sibling layout.

rules.title: Hard-coded local URL or unsafe http endpoint
rules.description: A committed source file hard-codes localhost/127.0.0.1 or an http:// URL that will break or leak in production.

rules.title: Env key used in code missing from .env.example
rules.description: process.env.KEY referenced in source with no matching key in .env.example/.env.sample — a fresh deploy fails or silently skips config.

rules.title: Critical flow with no test file
rules.description: Each route handler should have a test/spec file named after its directory (e.g. app/api/pay/route.ts ↔ pay.test.ts) somewhere in the repo.
